headline: Dangote Petroleum Refinery prepares for early December NGX listing
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery is on track to officially list on the Nigerian Exchange following a record IPO, pushing NGX equities market capitalization to N230 trillion.
why: Mega-cap listings on local exchanges significantly expand market capitalization, alter index weightings, and reshape institutional investment allocations in frontier markets.
